aboutStory.storyP1: Matii Technologies is a technology company engineering enterprise platforms, fintech infrastructures, BPO solutions, and data intelligence for organizations that cannot afford to fail.
aboutStory.storyP2: Founded in Ethiopia and built to global standards, we deliver secure, scalable systems for enterprise, government, and financial institutions.
aboutStory.storyP3: We don't just write code—we build the infrastructure that powers progress.
aboutStory.missionDesc: To engineer the systems that power enterprise, government, and finance, delivering technology that is reliable, secure, and built to scale.
aboutStory.visionDesc: Our ambition is to become one of the largest technology companies and the backbone of emerging markets—a company whose platforms run the systems that nations, institutions, and businesses depend on.
